questions.stem: A 30-year-old primigravida woman presents at 29 weeks gestation with headache and a blood pressure of 160/110 mm Hg. Investigations reveal 2+ proteinuria on dipstick, an elevated SGOT and SGPT and a platelet count of 80,000/mm3. What is the best management?

options.label: C
options.text: Magnesium sulphate therapy and induction of labour
